title: NVIDIA PAIR pools home computers for private local AI workloads
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA lets several home computers share local AI work
summary: NVIDIA released the PAIR beta, software that routes local inference requests across compatible RTX, DGX Spark and Apple M4-or-newer systems on one network. It presents a single endpoint to tools including Ollama and LM Studio while keeping prompts, files and agent context on the local network.
friendlySummary: PAIR connects supported Windows, Linux and Mac computers and sends AI jobs to machines that have spare capacity. The data stays on the local network.
whyItMatters: Homes and small teams can put idle hardware to work without sending sensitive inputs to a cloud model. PAIR distributes separate jobs rather than combining memory into one virtual GPU, so it is most useful for parallel workloads and still requires secure local networking and model management.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can make better use of computers you already own and keep private files at home. It does not turn several graphics cards into one giant graphics card.
